verses.20:107: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجࣰ ا وَلَآ أَمۡتࣰ ا

meaning: The root أمت (Amt) refers to a measure of distance, doubt, or disagreement. It also describes unevenness, like hills and valleys, or a defect/blemish.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
